baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يجزيهم, أحسن ما عملوا, يزيدهم من فضله, and بغير حساب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause ties an intentional deed to reciprocal recompense and favorable valuation; ثم-style coordination then adds growth sourced in non-obligatory gift, while the final construction excludes counting as the limit of provision.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal recompense supplies the deed-indexed first register.
Excellent action and benefaction supply an upward qualitative valuation, not bare equivalence.
Intentional action supplies the accountable input to recompense.
Addition and growth mark a second movement beyond the recompensed base.
A non-obligatory gift identifies the source and character of the increment.
Negation and exclusion remove account from the provision's bounding measure.
Counting and accounting name the measure that the final clause exceeds.

changed_reading.before: A single generic promise of generous reward.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two registers: deed-indexed recompense with favorable valuation, followed by a surplus provision that is not exhausted by the ledger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation of عمل, جزاء, فضل, and رزق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The work inventory permits wage and transaction images, reciprocal recompense supplies an earned due, and favor supplies a gift not owed by contract; provision is therefore both compensation and gratuity without collapsing the two.

activation_trace.role: The wage of work makes an earned-pay model available inside عملوا.
Interpersonal dealing gives the work a transactional edge.
Reciprocity supplies the due paid against work.
Gift beyond obligation prevents the whole promise from becoming a wage contract.
An allotted benefit gives the payment a concrete provisioning function.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds receive an undifferentiated reward.
changed_reading.after: The workers receive their due and then a noncontractual gratuity, so divine provision both honors work and exceeds its price.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يجزيهم followed by يزيدهم and يرزق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sufficing-substitution branch of recompense allows reward to be a new condition standing in place of a prior lack; increase and allotted benefit then make that replacement more than merely adequate.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for another thing and sufficing shifts recompense from transferred object to restored condition.
Growth carries the substituted condition beyond adequacy.
Gift supplies the non-equivalent excess in the restored condition.
An apportioned benefit gives the restoration a sustaining content.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an item transferred to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Recompense can restore by making a sufficient new state stand where lack stood, then increasing that state from favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah establishes bounded obligations and exact settlement, then immediately after the focus returns to a fully paid account. This makes بغير حساب a contrast internal to justice: deeds remain fully settled, while فضل and رزق exceed what settlement can price.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal recompense anchors the focus in a due-settlement register.
Non-obligatory gift supplies the register that exceeds due settlement.
Account is the explicit measure excluded from bounding provision.
A precisely bounded obligation establishes that the surah does not reject determinate measure.
Completion without deficiency supplies the norm of full settlement.
Reckoning and recompense identify the fully delivered due as an account.
The occurrence set culminates in an account fully settled and twice named immediately after the focus.

structural_cues: 24:2 and 24:4 specify exact numbers and evidentiary thresholds after the opening declaration of bounded obligation.
24:25 uses full payment, and 24:39 repeats حساب twice immediately after بغير حساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed measure, full settlement, and repeated account; I assign their sequence as an arrow from exact due to surplus beyond due. A live alternative is that بغير حساب only intensifies abundance without distinguishing two registers.

changed_reading.before: Without account means that measure and settlement are absent.
changed_reading.after: The surah preserves exact settlement for deeds but locates the added favor and provision beyond the ledger's ceiling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, human حسب first mislabels evil and good, then slight and grave, then mirage and water before becoming the noun for final account. The focus phrase can therefore exceed not only arithmetic count but the recipient's unreliable forecast of value, while أحسن names a superior valuation.

activation_trace.role: The good or beautiful supplies the focus's evaluative standard.
Supposition and estimation make a second live sense available under the negated account.
Human supposition labels the event evil before the ayah reverses that estimate.
Beneficial good supplies the value that overturns the first estimate.
A second human estimate makes grave speech seem slight.
A water-like shimmer materializes the false object produced by estimation.
Thirst supplies the need that bends expectation toward the mirage.
Actual water is the provision wrongly projected onto an empty appearance.

structural_cues: 24:11 and 24:15 overturn human estimates through evil/good and slight/grave reversals.
At 24:39 the same root moves within one ayah from supposing a mirage to the settled حساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reversals and the supposition/account polysemy; I let that sequence broaden the negated حساب from number to predictive valuation. The live alternative is simple lexical polysemy with no intended transfer into 24:38.

changed_reading.before: Provision is given in an amount too large to count.
changed_reading.after: Provision also escapes the recipients' mistaken projections of what is valuable or sustaining; the focus's best-value standard belongs to God, not their forecast.

context_deltas.mechanism: 24:21 sequences divine favor, growth-purification, and selection by will; 24:37 then places zakat immediately before the focus. This activates يزيدهم as qualitative cultivation and outwardly shared growth, not only addition to a private quantity.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth anchor the focus's added movement.
Gift supplies the source of cultivation beyond earned due.
Divine will governs the focus's distribution of provision.
Favor is explicitly made the condition for a transformation no person produces alone.
Growth and increase give the transformation a developmental mechanism.
Purity and rectification make that growth qualitative as well as quantitative.
The same will formula selects the recipient of purification before it selects provision.
Zakat places increase in an outward transfer immediately before the focus promise.

structural_cues: 24:21 contains the sequence فضل, زكا, من يشاء that anticipates يزيدهم من فضله and يرزق من يشاء.
24:30 calls disciplined restraint أزكى, while 24:37 places zakat directly before 24:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated favor-growth-will sequence; I infer that the focus's increase may grow and purify persons and relations, not merely holdings. Material increase remains a live co-reading.

changed_reading.before: The added favor is a larger quantity of reward.
changed_reading.after: The favor cultivates and purifies the recipients and can become outwardly shared increase, so the gift changes capacity and character as well as amount.

context_deltas.mechanism: Favor first protects recipients, then appears as surplus and capacity held by people who must give; it next moves poverty toward sufficiency and funds a release contract from wealth identified as God's. The focus's added فضل thus enters a circulation mechanism rather than ending as private possession.

activation_trace.role: Surplus beyond need anchors a transferable excess in the focus.
An apportioned benefit gives the surplus a livelihood-facing destination.
Surplus is now held by human agents and made socially answerable.
Material amplitude supplies the capacity from which giving can occur.
Giving turns held capacity into movement toward kin, the poor, and migrants.
Material need identifies a concrete lack that favor addresses.
Sufficiency, not mere accumulation, names the social effect of divine favor.
The emancipation contract gives transferred wealth a freedom-producing mechanism.
Property identified as God's supplies the material to be passed onward.

structural_cues: 24:10, 24:14, 24:20, and 24:21 repeatedly present people as recipients of divine فضل before 24:22 addresses people who possess فضل.
24:22 commands giving; 24:32-33 move from poverty to sufficiency and from owned status toward contracted freedom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated favor, held amplitude, giving, poverty, sufficiency, and release; I infer a circulation arrow from divine excess through human hands to restored agency. The focus may still promise a private or eschatological gift without specifying onward transfer.

changed_reading.before: His favor is an extra reward possessed by the rewarded individuals.
changed_reading.after: His favor is capacity that can circulate into livelihood, sufficiency, and release, so uncounted provision repairs social relations as well as rewarding persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, profit-seeking trade and priced exchange fail to distract people who rise to maintain prayer and transfer zakat. The work-wage branch in 24:38 is therefore revalued: worship and giving are the real intentional labor, but their recompense exceeds any sale price through فضل.

activation_trace.role: Work's wage supplies a payment model for the focus's deeds.
Human transaction supplies the economic frame that context will reverse.
Reciprocal recompense preserves a due for the work.
Gift beyond obligation breaks the equivalence of a market wage.
The pursuit of profit supplies the market activity explicitly subordinated.
Exchange against a price supplies the contract model that cannot value the coming reward.
Rising deliberately to a task makes prayer maintained work rather than passive identity.
The specified worship supplies one concrete content of ما عملوا.
Growth expressed through zakat supplies the other concrete work and redirects gain outward.

structural_cues: 24:37 and 24:38 form an immediate actor-action-recompense sequence.
Trade and sale are named before remembrance, maintained prayer, and zakat, while reward is then described with work, recompense, favor, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies market terms beside worship and work-wage branches; I infer an alternative economy in which the latter acts are labor whose value no sale price fixes. The live alternative is a simpler distraction contrast with no wage metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The focus rewards generic pious deeds after an unrelated warning about commerce.
changed_reading.after: The focus answers a market scene by treating sustained worship and giving as the work of highest value, paying its due while refusing to reduce it to a price.

context_deltas.mechanism: The provision inventory itself includes descending rain; later the surah assembles clouds, sends rain to or turns it from whomever God wills, then makes water the substrate of proliferating creaturely forms. Uncounted provision becomes a life-generating distribution whose yield multiplies beyond the initial allotment.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending as provision gives the focus's رزق an ecological material form.
Divine will governs who receives that provision.
Growth lets received provision produce more than its initial amount.
Falling rain supplies the concrete provision released from gathered cloud.
Delivery downward supplies the vector by which provision reaches recipients.
The repeated will formula directs both the rain's arrival and its diversion.
Water supplies the shared substance from which creaturely life proceeds.
Creative bringing-forth converts one provision into diverse living forms.

structural_cues: 24:43 repeats من يشاء while distributing rain, closely echoing يرزق من يشاء.
24:45 follows with every creature made from water and another ما يشاء formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rain branch for رزق and a will-directed rain-to-life sequence; I infer that uncountedness includes generative yield beyond the delivered water. The alternative is that rain is only one example of provision and does not specify 24:38.

changed_reading.before: Provision is an abstract or monetary allotment added to reward.
changed_reading.after: Provision can descend like rain, be differentially directed, and generate proliferating life, so its excess lies partly in what the gift enables to grow.

context_deltas.mechanism: 24:55 repeats believing and intended righteous action, then promises a chain of substitutions: successors stand where others stood, empowerment replaces incapacity, and security replaces fear. This activates the focus's sufficing-substitution branch of جزاء as transformed condition rather than only transferred pay.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing substitution anchors recompense as one condition standing in place of another.
Increase makes the replacement an enlarged capacity rather than a neutral exchange.
The same intentional righteous action reconnects the later promise to ما عملوا.
Successors coming after and standing in another's place materialize substitution at a public scale.
Empowerment supplies the increased capacity produced by the replacement.
One state standing in place of another explicitly carries fear toward security.
Belief and settled security share an occurrence set, giving the new state inward stability.

structural_cues: 24:55 repeats الذين آمنوا and عملوا الصالحات before three emphatic future promises.
The promise progresses through succession, establishment, and the explicit replacement of fear with security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated action and a chain of standing-in-place transformations; I infer that these are a concrete mode of the focus's recompense. The alternative is that 24:55 is a separate communal promise rather than an unpacking of 24:38.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is chiefly a reward object delivered after action.
changed_reading.after: Recompense can be the replacement of a vulnerable condition by empowered, secure capacity, extending reward from possession to public transformation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant mapped ج ز ز inventory under يجزيهم. It remains anchored by the packet's explicit split mapping and by focus growth and rain-provision branches, while tree, oil, and rain context give the image a coherent material cycle. Downstream prose should label it a harvest analogy, not a claim that the surface verb morphologically means cutting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يجزيهم through the supplied ج ز ز split, joined to يزيدهم and the rain branch of يرزق.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness for cutting turns the moment of recompense into harvest time.
Growth supplies the crop's development beyond its earlier state.
Rain as provision supplies what sustains and renews growth.
A fruit-bearing tree gives the growth-harvest mechanism a living body.
Oil as provision and gift makes harvested yield itself sustaining surplus.
Descending rain closes the cycle from provision to renewed growth.

changed_reading.before: Recompense closes a ledger at the endpoint of action.
changed_reading.after: Recompense can be pictured as harvesting action when ripe, while added favor and rain-like provision feed another cycle of growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the non-dominant ز و د target supplied under يزيدهم. It remains anchored in that split inventory and gains coherence from destination, straight path, and return context. Render it only as a secondary journey image, not as an etymological replacement for ordinary increase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يزيدهم through the supplied ز و د target, with فضل as the source of what is carried.

activation_trace.role: Carried provisions for transition recast increase as equipment for a journey.
Gift supplies the provisions rather than the traveler earning or packing them alone.
Movement toward an ultimate destination gives the provision a journey horizon.
A straight route supplies the path on which carried provision functions.
Return supplies the journey's terminal movement back to the giver.

changed_reading.before: The increase is a static addition possessed at reward time.
changed_reading.after: The increase can be carried provision that equips recipients for the path and return, making favor enabling rather than merely accumulative.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Calling light a provision is cross-domain because رزق does not itself name illumination here. The reading remains anchored in رزق as beneficial allotment and in the repeated من يشاء formula linking light-guidance to provision across the immediate passage. Downstream prose should present an analogy of nonmaterial provision, not identify رزق and نور lexically.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يرزق من يشاء as an allotted benefit governed by will.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned benefit permits provision to include a nonmaterial good.
Will supplies the selection formula shared with the light passage.
Illumination supplies the beneficial good repeatedly layered in the passage leading to the focus.
Gentle direction to the path makes light function as an enabling gift.
The same will formula allocates guidance to light before it allocates provision.
The stated absence of any light without divine giving sharpens its gift-like dependence.

changed_reading.before: Provision denotes material allotment after recompense.
changed_reading.after: Provision may analogically include light and guidance, an enabling benefit allocated by the same will and impossible to self-produce.

strongest_changes: Exact obligation and full settlement make فضل and رزق an excess beyond justice, not an absence of justice.
Repeated حسب reversals expand بغير حساب from uncountable amount to freedom from unreliable human valuation.
The فضل, زكا, من يشاء sequence turns increase into purification and socially circulating capacity.
The rain and water sequence gives provision a life-generating material mechanism whose yield multiplies.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition made the focus pivot between ledger, gift, estimation, market, social repair, and ecology without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أحسن ما عملوا sets the best deeds as the reward measure or describes a generally favorable recompense remains grammatically open.
The replacement model is well anchored but may belong chiefly to 24:55 rather than define 24:38.
Harvest, journey provision, and light should remain explicitly analogical because their mechanisms depend on split or cross-domain branches.
